## Security and licensing checklist
- [ ] No secrets, customer information, or private APOS material
- [ ] New code is original or properly licensed
- [ ] Tests and documentation updated as applicable
- [ ] Accessibility, localization and low-bandwidth implications considered

## Public redistribution review

- [ ] Independently authored or compatible licensed content; attribution retained.
- [ ] Synthetic examples only; no private code, customer records, infrastructure values or supplier credentials.
- [ ] Shared component behavior, compatibility and downstream impact documented.
- [ ] Tests and public-boundary checks pass; security reports use private reporting.
